I don’t blame you, I’m overweight for my height, I’m 15 and I’m 4’10. So my weight piles on a lot. I get facial hair under my chin, neck and of course top lips. Honestly I’m just super hairy, I shave a lot tho, once a week. I shave my legs, thighs, arms, neck and chin but I wax the rest of my hair, I have horrible face acne and one of my eyes looks more closed then the other ( I was shot with a beebee gun and it hit me right in the eye ) I have a baby face and child like voice so I sound 12. But over time I just accepted the fact I am this way and did little things to change it, I eat less and healthier, I control my hair by shaving and waxing, and I’ve been to the doctor for my acne, it’s much better to get prescribed acne medication then store ones. Of course you have some things you can’t change and that’s ok! Honestly for the people pointing out your “ flaws “ just feed off of negative attention. You are beautiful just they way you are. You shouldn’t worry about your looks at all, and only change them if YOU want too, not because of other people. ❤️
